note: The one list both gates are pinned to: packages/runtime-agent/src/jobs/card_text.rs and packages/frontend/src/screens/studio/components/packCardText.ts. A rule changed on one side and not the other fails a test on both. `expected` is null when the string is refused whole; the card then renders its own wording for the absence. `names` pins the human-credential refusal both gates derive from the variable name alone, and `identities` pins the catalogue identity table both gates carry a copy of.
